source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 5 同主题完形(在饭店用钞票/旅行丢钱怎么办/第一次理财/慈善义卖/省钱小窍门/学会感恩)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: Dinner with a Strange Note
passages.text: Henry walked into a small restaurant, feeling very (1)____ because he had not eaten all day. A waiter showed him to a table, though the owner clearly thought such a poor-looking man could not (2)____ a proper meal. Henry ordered a large dinner and ate it slowly. When the bill came, he quietly handed over his huge bank (3)____. The waiter's eyes grew wide, and he hurried to fetch the (4)____. "Could this really be the famous note from the (5)____?" the owner wondered aloud. At once their cold (6)____ changed into warm smiles. They said Henry could come back (7)____ he liked and order whatever he wished. To them, just having such a rich (8)____ in the room was a great honour. Henry was (9)____ at how quickly people's behaviour could change. He realised that the same dinner had been served with a frown one minute and a smile the (10)____.

afford a meal 买得起一顿饭。
bank note 钞票。
去叫来 the owner 老板。
the famous note from the papers 报纸上的钞票。
cold manner 冷淡的态度。
come back whenever he liked 想来就来。
such a rich guest 这样一位富客。
be surprised at 对……感到惊讶。
with a smile the next (minute) 下一分钟就笑脸相迎。

passages.title: What to Do If You Lose Your Money Abroad
passages.text: Imagine you are travelling in a foreign country when you suddenly find that your money is (1)____. This situation is frightening, but you should try to stay (2)____. First, go to your nearest (3)____, where the staff can help you to some (4)____. They may not give you cash, but they can offer useful advice. Second, you (5)____ to check with local charities, which sometimes (6)____ help to travellers in need. Whatever you do, you must not let fear (7)____ you to do something foolish. Some people might (8)____ that stealing food would solve the problem, but getting caught could ruin your whole (9)____. Most importantly, always keep a little cash hidden in a safe place (10)____ such an emergency happens. A calm traveller who plans ahead will get through almost any trouble.

questions.explanation: your money is gone 钱不见了。
stay calm 保持冷静。
go to the consulate 去领事馆。
to some extent 在一定程度上。
you ought to check 你应当核实。
offer help 提供帮助。
let fear cause you 让恐惧使你……。
might think that 也许会以为。
ruin your whole life 毁掉你的一生。
in case such an emergency happens 以防发生这种紧急情况。

passages.title: My First Time Managing Money
passages.text: When I turned twelve, my parents began to give me a small amount of pocket money every (1)____. At first I spent it all at once on snacks and toys, and by the next day my pockets were (2)____ again. My mother gently told me that money was a good (3)____ but a bad master, and that I (4)____ learn to control it. So I made a simple (5)____: I divided my money into three parts. One part I could (6)____ on small treats, one part I would (7)____ for something bigger, and one part I gave to children in (8)____. It was not easy to wait, and it taught me real (9)____. A few months later, I had saved enough to buy the bicycle I had always wanted. That day I felt proud, because I had earned it through my own (10)____.

questions.explanation: every week 每周。
pockets were empty again 口袋又空了。
a good servant 好仆人(呼应名言)。
ought to learn 应当学会。
made a simple plan 做了个简单的计划。
spend on small treats 花在小零食上。
save for something bigger 为更大的东西攒钱。
children in need 有需要的孩子。
taught me real patience 教会我真正的耐心。
through my own effort 靠自己的努力。

passages.title: The School Charity Sale
passages.text: Last month our class held a charity (1)____ to raise money for a sick classmate. Everyone brought old books, toys and clothes that were still in good (2)____. We set up tables in the playground and put a clear (3)____ on each item. At first I was nervous and (4)____ to call out to passers-by, but soon I grew braver. Many parents were (5)____ to pay a little more than we asked, just to support a good (6)____. By the end of the day, we had raised far more money than we had ever (7)____. None of us kept a single cent for (8)____; every coin went to help our classmate's family. The best part was not the money itself, but the warm feeling of doing something (9)____ together. I learned that even a small (10)____ of kindness can make a real difference to someone in trouble.

questions.explanation: a charity sale 慈善义卖。
in good condition 状况良好。
put a clear price 标个清楚的价格。
hesitated to call out 迟疑着不敢叫卖。
were willing to pay 愿意多付。
support a good cause 支持公益事业。
more than we had hoped 比我们期望的还多。
kept… for ourselves 给自己留。
doing something good 做好事。
a small act of kindness 一个小小的善举。

passages.title: Smart Ways to Save Money
passages.text: Saving money is a skill that anyone can (1)____ with a little practice. The first step is to know exactly where your money (2)____ each week. Many people are surprised to find how much they waste on things they do not really (3)____. A useful habit is to wait a day before buying anything that is not (4)____; often the wish to buy it simply goes away. You should also try to (5)____ a small sum regularly, even if it is only a few coins. Over time, these coins (6)____ into a useful amount. When you shop, compare (7)____ before you decide, and never let a clever advertisement (8)____ you into buying what you do not need. Saving does not mean you can never (9)____ yourself; it means spending on what truly matters. Step by step, these simple habits will give you greater (10)____ over your own money.

questions.explanation: a skill anyone can learn 人人都能学会。
where your money goes 钱花到哪去了。
do not really need 并不真的需要。
not necessary 并非必需。
save a small sum 存一小笔。
these coins grow into 这些硬币会增长为。
compare prices 比较价格。
let an advertisement fool you 让广告骗了你。
enjoy yourself 享受生活。
greater control over your money 对钱更有掌控力。

passages.title: Learning to Be Thankful
passages.text: My grandfather grew up very (1)____, and his family often had little to eat. Yet whenever he tells me about those days, he never (2)____. Instead, he says that being poor taught him to value every small (3)____ in life. He learned to fix his own shoes, to share what he had, and to be (4)____ for even a warm meal. "Money," he often says, "can buy many things, but it cannot buy a happy (5)____." Today our family is more comfortable, but he still hates to (6)____ anything. He keeps a little notebook in which he writes down the things he is thankful (7)____ each day. At first I thought this was a strange (8)____, but slowly I began to understand. Counting your blessings, he says, makes you feel (9)____ no matter how much you own. Because of him, I have learned that true wealth is not about how much you have, but how (10)____ you feel for what you have.

questions.explanation: grew up very poor 家境贫寒。
never complains 从不抱怨。
every small gift in life 生活中每件小小的恩赐。
be thankful for 心怀感激。
a happy heart 一颗快乐的心。

thankful for 对……感激。
a strange habit 一个奇怪的习惯。

how thankful you feel 你有多感恩。
